verdict.rationale: Texas SOS publishes SOSPortal's operating-hours window up front on its public pages: it is stated to be available 24/7, alongside the per-search fee. Nothing in the evidence documents a session timeout or any per-day filing or search limit. Missing for 10: published session-timeout policy, published per-day limits (or an explicit statement that none exist), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start

citations.quote: The access model is published: "SOSPortal is available 24/7. There is a $1.00 statutorily authorized fee associated with each search."
